about.hero.title: About GoWithPorto
about.hero.subtitle: A Porto-based project built by people who love this city, made to help travelers experience it the way locals do.
about.story.title: Our Story
about.story.p1: GoWithPorto started with a simple frustration: planning a trip to Porto usually means juggling a dozen tabs — blog posts, review sites, booking platforms — just to figure out what to see and where to buy something genuinely local. We built GoWithPorto to bring that all into one place, powered by a bit of AI and a lot of local knowledge.
about.story.p2: We're based in Porto, Portugal, and we're still a small, independent team — which means every shop in our marketplace and every recommendation on the platform is chosen with care, not mass-listed.
about.mission.title: Our Mission
about.mission.p1: To make planning a Porto trip effortless, and to give independent local businesses — shops, guides, rental partners — a genuine way to reach the travelers who'd love to find them.
about.offer.title: What We Offer
about.offer.ai.title: AI Trip Planner
about.offer.ai.description: Tell us your dates, interests, and pace — our AI puts together a personalized Porto itinerary in moments, ready to save and follow.
about.offer.attractions.title: Attractions & Local Experiences
about.offer.attractions.description: From the Dom Luís I Bridge to hidden viewpoints, discover the landmarks and local experiences that make Porto worth exploring on foot.
about.offer.shop.title: Souvenir Marketplace
about.offer.shop.description: Authentic finds from independent Porto shops and makers, delivered to your door — every purchase supports a local business directly.
about.offer.bikes.title: Bike Rentals
about.offer.bikes.description: Book a bike and see the city at your own pace, with pickup and return handled by local rental partners.

about.cta.subtitle: Whether you're planning a trip or you run a shop in Porto, we'd love to hear from you.
faq.hero.title: Help Center
faq.hero.subtitlePre: Answers to the questions we hear most about planning, booking, and shopping with GoWithPorto. Can't find what you need?
faq.q.gs1.a: GoWithPorto is your personal AI travel companion for exploring Porto. Plan a personalized itinerary with our AI trip planner, discover top attractions and local experiences, book bike rentals, and shop authentic souvenirs from independent local shops — all in one place.
faq.q.gs2.q: Do I need an account to use GoWithPorto?
faq.q.gs2.a: You can browse attractions, local experiences, and the souvenir shop without signing in. To save a trip, generate an AI itinerary, add items to your cart, or check out, you'll need to sign in with your Google account.
faq.q.gs3.q: How does the AI trip planner work?
faq.q.gs3.a: Head to the AI Planner, tell it your dates, interests, and pace, and it generates a personalized Porto itinerary in moments. Every generation uses one AI credit. Your past itineraries are saved under My Trips in your dashboard so you can revisit them anytime.
faq.q.gs4.q: What are AI credits and how do I get more?
faq.q.gs4.a: AI credits power the itinerary generator — one credit is used each time you generate a trip plan. You can purchase small credit packs securely through Stripe checkout whenever you need more.
faq.q.gs5.q: Which languages does the site support?
faq.q.gs5.a: GoWithPorto is currently available in English, French, Spanish, and Portuguese. Use the language switcher (globe icon) in the header to change language at any time.
faq.q.op1.q: How do I pay for souvenirs or bookings?
faq.q.op1.a: All payments are processed securely through Stripe at checkout. We accept major debit and credit cards. Card details are handled entirely by Stripe — GoWithPorto never stores your full card number.
faq.q.op2.a: Yes. Go to Dashboard → Order History to see the status of every order. You'll also receive email confirmations when an order is placed and when it ships.
faq.q.op3.q: What is your refund and returns policy?
faq.q.op3.a: Souvenirs are sold and fulfilled by independent local Porto shops, so exact return terms can vary by item — check the product listing for details. If something arrives damaged, wrong, or doesn't show up, contact our support team and we'll help resolve it with the seller.
faq.q.op4.q: Is my payment information stored on GoWithPorto?
faq.q.op4.a: No. Card details are collected and processed directly by Stripe, our PCI-compliant payment provider. GoWithPorto's servers never see or store your full card number.
faq.q.mk1.q: Who sells the souvenirs on GoWithPorto?
faq.q.mk1.a: Every item in the Souvenir Marketplace is listed and fulfilled by an independent local Porto shop or maker, not by GoWithPorto directly. This helps us support small local businesses while giving you authentic, hand-picked finds.
faq.q.mk2.a: Shipping is handled by the individual store owner behind each product, so timelines can vary slightly by shop. You'll see estimated shipping details before completing checkout.
faq.q.mk3.q: I run a shop in Porto — can I sell on GoWithPorto?
faq.q.mk3.a: We're always happy to hear from local shop owners. Reach out through our Contact Support page with a bit about your shop and products, and our team will follow up about joining the marketplace.
faq.q.bk1.a: Browse available bikes under Bike Rentals, choose your dates and pickup location, and complete your booking through checkout. Details on pickup and return are included in your booking confirmation.
faq.q.bk2.q: Can I cancel or change a bike rental booking?
faq.q.bk2.a: Yes — contact our support team as soon as possible with your order number and we'll help you cancel or adjust your booking wherever the rental partner allows it.
faq.q.ap1.a: GoWithPorto uses Google Sign-In for a fast, secure login — there's no separate password to remember. Just click Login and continue with your Google account.
faq.q.ap2.q: How do I delete my account or personal data?
faq.q.ap2.a: Contact our support team from the Contact Support page and we'll process your deletion request. See our Privacy Policy for full details on what we collect and your rights.
faq.q.ap3.a: Yes — your data is stored on encrypted, access-restricted infrastructure hosted in the EU, and we only work with reputable processors (Google, Stripe, Cloudinary) for the specific tasks they perform. Full details are in our Privacy Policy.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: This policy explains what personal data GoWithPorto collects, why, and the rights you have over it under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
privacy.section.whoWeAre.title: 1. Who We Are
privacy.section.whoWeAre.p1: GoWithPorto ("GoWithPorto", "we", "us") is a Porto-based tourism platform that helps travelers plan trips, book bike rentals and local experiences, and shop souvenirs from independent local shops in Porto, Portugal. GoWithPorto is the data controller responsible for your personal data described in this policy.
privacy.section.whoWeAre.contactPrefix: Questions about this policy or your data can be sent to
privacy.section.collect.title: 2. Information We Collect
privacy.section.collect.intro: We collect the minimum data needed to run the service:
privacy.section.collect.item.account.tex: — name, email address, and profile picture, provided by Google when you sign in with your Google account. We do not receive or store your Google password.
privacy.section.collect.item.orders.text: — items purchased, shipping details, and order status for souvenirs, bike rentals, and local experiences.
privacy.section.collect.item.payment.tex: — handled entirely by our payment processor, Stripe. GoWithPorto never receives or stores your full card number.
privacy.section.collect.item.aiInputs.te: — the dates, interests, and preferences you enter to generate an itinerary, and the itineraries generated for you, saved under "My Trips" in your account.
privacy.section.collect.item.storeConten: — if you sell on our marketplace, product listings and images you upload.
privacy.section.collect.item.contactForm: — the name, email, and message you submit through our Contact Support page.
privacy.section.collect.item.technical.t: — IP address and basic request metadata, used briefly for security purposes such as rate-limiting login attempts.
privacy.section.howWeUse.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
privacy.section.howWeUse.item1: To create and manage your account and let you sign in securely.
privacy.section.howWeUse.item2: To process orders and bookings, and send confirmation and shipping emails.
privacy.section.howWeUse.item3: To generate AI trip itineraries based on the preferences you provide.
privacy.section.howWeUse.item4: To respond to messages sent through our Contact Support page.
privacy.section.howWeUse.item5: To detect and prevent fraud, abuse, and unauthorized access.
privacy.section.howWeUse.item6: To meet our legal and accounting obligations.
privacy.section.howWeUse.noSell: We do not sell your personal data, and we do not use it for third-party advertising.
privacy.section.legalBasis.title: 4. Legal Basis for Processing
privacy.section.legalBasis.intro: Under the GDPR, we rely on the following legal bases:
privacy.section.legalBasis.item.contract: — processing needed to create your account, fulfil orders/bookings, and deliver AI itineraries you request.
privacy.section.legalBasis.item.legitima: — keeping the platform secure (e.g. rate-limiting), and responding to support requests.
privacy.section.legalBasis.item.legalObl: — retaining order and payment records as required by tax and accounting law.
privacy.section.cookies.title: 5. Cookies & Similar Technologies
privacy.section.cookies.p1: GoWithPorto uses a small number of strictly necessary cookies: a secure session cookie to keep you signed in, and a preference cookie to remember your chosen language. We do not use third-party advertising or tracking cookies.
privacy.section.cookies.p2: When you check out, our payment processor Stripe also sets its own cookies (such as __stripe_mid and __stripe_sid) to detect and prevent payment fraud. These are essential to process your payment securely and cannot be disabled while still allowing you to check out.
privacy.section.sharing.title: 6. Who We Share Data With
privacy.section.sharing.intro: We only share personal data with service providers who process it on our behalf, strictly to run the service:
privacy.section.sharing.item.mongodb.tex: — our database provider, hosted in the EU (Paris, France region).
— for storing and serving product and profile images.
privacy.section.sharing.item.resend.text: — for delivering transactional emails (order confirmations, receipts, welcome emails).
privacy.section.sharing.item.groq.label: Groq API
privacy.section.sharing.item.groq.text: — to generate AI trip itineraries from the preferences you provide.
privacy.section.sharing.outro: Each provider is contractually restricted to using your data only to provide their service to us. We may also disclose data where required by law.
privacy.section.transfers.title: 7. International Data Transfers
privacy.section.transfers.p1: Some of our service providers (such as Google, Stripe, and Resend) may process data outside the European Economic Area, including in the United States. Where this happens, we rely on providers that offer appropriate safeguards, such as Standard Contractual Clauses, to protect your data in line with GDPR requirements.
privacy.section.retention.title: 8. Data Retention
privacy.section.retention.p1: We keep account data for as long as your account is active. Order and payment records are kept as required by Portuguese tax and accounting law. Contact form messages are kept only as long as needed to resolve your request. You can ask us to delete your account and associated data at any time — see Section 9.
privacy.section.yourRights.title: 9. Your Rights
privacy.section.yourRights.intro: Under the GDPR, you have the right to:
privacy.section.yourRights.item1: Access the personal data we hold about you.
privacy.section.yourRights.item3: Request deletion of your data ("right to be forgotten").
privacy.section.yourRights.item4: Restrict or object to certain processing.
privacy.section.yourRights.item5: Receive your data in a portable format.
privacy.section.yourRights.item6: Withdraw consent at any time, where processing is based on consent.
privacy.section.yourRights.exercisePrefi: To exercise any of these rights, email
privacy.section.yourRights.complaintSuff: . You also have the right to lodge a complaint with Portugal's data protection authority, the Comissão Nacional de Proteção de Dados (CNPD).
privacy.section.children.title: 10. Children's Privacy
privacy.section.children.p1: GoWithPorto is not directed at children, and we do not knowingly collect personal data from anyone under 16. If you believe a child has provided us with personal data, please contact us and we will delete it.
privacy.section.security.title: 11. Data Security
privacy.section.security.p1: We use industry-standard safeguards to protect your data, including encrypted connections (HTTPS), access-restricted databases, and secure authentication. No method of transmission or storage is 100% secure, but we work to protect your information using commercially reasonable measures.
privacy.section.changes.title: 12. Changes to This Policy
privacy.section.changes.p1: We may update this policy from time to time as our service evolves. Material changes will be reflected by updating the "Last updated" date at the top of this page.
privacy.section.contactUs.title: 13. Contact Us
privacy.section.contactUs.prefix: For any questions about this Privacy Policy or how your data is handled, reach us at
privacy.section.contactUs.suffix: page. We're based in Porto, Portugal.
cookieConsent.message: We use essential cookies to keep you signed in, remember your language, and let Stripe securely process payments and detect fraud. We don't use advertising or tracking cookies.
